findings.reason: the 64-wide batch, and the per-slice wall and forward-solves-per-reconstruction it reports, cannot be obtained from §4's declared dependency, so the cost measurement needs its case source named or its depends-on corrected to §7.

findings.reason: the deferred node's whole gate reduces to a presence check that cannot fail, so a retained reconstruction's standing is asserted by its column's existence rather than measured; a control naming a degraded reconstruction that must rank worse would restore a measure that can fail.
findings.text: §5 declares no negative control, and under the "keep" branch its only measure is that the §3 table "carries one column group per retained reconstruction", which holds however badly a retained reconstruction performs

rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §1, §2 and §6 to §9 each declare a control that can fire. §5 declares none and its "keep" branch reduces to a presence check.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the record docs/evidence/archive/inverse-equilibrium-baseline-landed.html resolves and every gate is written to it or to a named H200/titan job, not to a scratchpad.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag reaches a symbol; sections name quantities and bands only, and where a mechanism is implied (§9's linear flux update, §6's chi-square interval) it is stated as the quantity to be measured rather than as code to write.
rubric_items.reasoning: findings — §2 asserts a landed measured outcome its own declaration and record contradict, and §4 times a batch of ITER slices no declared dependency delivers; the chi-square interval stated in §6 was checked and holds (31 dof, six directions, 99% joint coverage: 0.386 to 1.992, matching the stated 0.39 to 1.99).
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each of §1 to §9 carries one deliverable (recovery, EFIT comparison, scoreboard, H200 cost, disposition of three reconstructions, covariance honesty, drift, imas-efit on nova rows, iterative fit).
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — every depends-on in the node table resolves and matches the section prose (§3, §4 wait on §8; §5 on §3; §7 on §6+§3+§8; §9 on neither), but §2 hands its measured forward-solve refusals to a plan that is never named and never wired.
